import { selectRecord } from './generated/architecture_callable_fixture.generated.js';
import { float16Values } from './generated/consumer_fixture.generated.js';

type Float16Value = number | Float16Value[];
type GeneratedFloat16Value = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof float16Values>>;

const float16Result: Promise<Float16Value> = float16Values();
const acceptsScalar: number extends GeneratedFloat16Value ? true : never = true;
const acceptsArray: number[] extends GeneratedFloat16Value ? true : never = true;

// @ts-expect-error A decoded float16 array is not a string.
const wrongFloat16Result: Promise<string> = float16Values();

const textRecord: Promise<Record<string, Record<string, string>>> = selectRecord('label');
const integerRecord: Promise<Record<string, Record<string, number>>> = selectRecord(42);

// @ts-expect-error An integer input must not infer a string record.
const wrongTextRecord: Promise<Record<string, Record<string, string>>> = selectRecord(42);

// @ts-expect-error A string input must not infer an integer record.
const wrongIntegerRecord: Promise<Record<string, Record<string, number>>> = selectRecord('label');

// @ts-expect-error A boolean input matches no overload.
selectRecord(true);

void textRecord;
void integerRecord;
void wrongTextRecord;
void wrongIntegerRecord;
void float16Result;
void wrongFloat16Result;
void acceptsScalar;
void acceptsArray;
